resources.string:
Optional recovery from this installation’s pinyin_simp.userdb. First explicitly apply bundled Wanxiang Base, keeping compatible supplements and patches. Preview will not switch away from another base or an old runtime fallback.

Input pauses while a closed copy is made. The original database and a verified pristine snapshot are retained; only another working copy is opened.

Supported active phrases become a separate dictionary with weight max(1, commit count). Dynamic ranking, recency, context, statistics and deletion behavior are not transferred. Deleted records stay in the original and are excluded; unsupported records block activation. Original learning files are never renamed or replaced.

Review counts before adding the dictionary. This is not a complete learning-database migration. A retained snapshot must be explicitly discarded before making another preview.

Add this dictionary as a supplement to the currently applied word tables and custom configuration? Unsaved choices on this screen are not applied. If old learning or the applied selection changed after preview, confirmation is refused. Compilation and an input probe must succeed before switching. Failed deployment retains the old selection and the imported recovery source.

Delete only this recovery’s snapshot, working copy and preview? The original Pinyin database, imported recovered dictionary and applied selection remain. Retain the snapshot until you have verified the recovered phrases.
